description: The FULL published ranking table in rank order for one system, from the newest week at or before as_of. Rows carry player_name as published and a null player_id for players outside our roster, so the table has no silent holes. ATP/WTA history runs deep. The ITF circuits begin 2026-07-29. For point-in-time records of SPECIFIC players use get_player_rankings. Requires the PRO plan.

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Serves the newest published week at or before this date. Omit for latest.

system.description: Ranking system to list. utr has no listing, because it is a rating, not a ranking.

name: get_rankings

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

effective_date.description: The publication week this record took effect, YYYY-MM-DD.

player_id.description: Roster player id. Null on listing rows for players outside our roster.

player_name.description: Name as the ranking publisher printed it (listing rows).

previous_rank.description: Rank at the preceding snapshot week (ATP/WTA only, null elsewhere).

rank.description: Null for UTR (a rating, not a ranking).

rank_movement.description: The circuit's own signed weekly movement (ITF systems only).

system.description: atp, wta, itf_jt, itf_mt, itf_wt or utr. Systems are never comparable.

title: Rankings listing
